venues.name: D&C DC
venues.notes_summary: **DC — Thursday 2/26.** Busy from the jump: full room at 7pm with a waitlist queue; all reservations in by 8:30, then energy fizzled and alley foot traffic dropped steeply; bar empty by 10:30; last guest seated before 11; last call at midnight. Apparently a weird night across the alley (Callico and Tigerfork closed early, the Dabney did final seatings at 9). Comps $70 (DNL). Kitchen: very strong dinner with multi-course tables; 86'd within the first 2-3 hours: cheese plate, wagyu tartare, bread and butter, tuna crudo (later back), donuts. MOD: Kevin / Cory.

venues.name: D&C EV
venues.notes_summary: **EV — Thursday 2/26.** Slow start to a bustling Thursday; guests chill, no one needed to be pushed out; many tables sat on nothing at the end enjoying company. A pair at T3/T4 insisted on sitting side by side, causing tightness. Comps $161.90 (2.8%, more DNL than usual). Top sellers: Masari, Year of the Trees, Revenant. Door: warmer Thursday, slower 6pm, good 8pm wave of twos with a tiny waitlist, mostly at cap from 9:30, cozy twos around midnight; welcomed Seth from Bateman's with his parents and Tyler from Maison Premiere for a birthday. No no-shows. Kitchen: none. (Form typed 'Thursday 2/27'; actual date 2/26.)
